prompt: A parent object, two new associated objects, first hour of data. Name the event, and the first action the governing procedure requires.
plot_description: Range from the parent against time. Two pieces, both departing at moderate rates in opposite directions, with only the first hour of data and no further revisit yet.
accepted_first_actions: characterise how the count is growing
count the associated objects and characterise the growth
expert_cue: Opposite directions is weak evidence for fragmentation and two pieces is weak evidence for separation. In the first hour the count has not had time to stop growing, so the honest answer is indeterminate.
